name: frontend-design
title_zh: 先问「这界面在替谁说话」再动手的视觉设计顾问
tagline_zh: 受够了千篇一律的 Tailwind 模板脸？它逼你先定气质再选字体，从排版到配色每一步都给出「不像默认款」的理由。
tagline_en: Tired of cookie-cutter Tailwind faces? It forces a personality call first, then audits type & color so nothing.
desc_en: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.
why_zh: 不给你色板或组件库，而是先逼你回答「这界面该有什么性格」。
why_en: No palettes or component kits. It interrogates your UI's character first, then audits every visual choice against that stance.
limit_zh: 只出方向和判断，不生成代码、不产出设计稿文件；需要你已有可运行的界面或线框；对纯后端、无 UI 的项目毫无用处。
limit_en: Judgment only: no code, no design files. Needs an existing UI or wireframe. Useless for pure backend or non-visual projects.
title_en: A visual design coach that asks who the UI speaks for.
